# Chinese release inventory and QA readiness

<!-- Generated by scripts/chinese_release_inventory.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Catalogue: manifest `zh-2024-p2p3-draft.2` (proposed_not_import_enabled), batch `zh-starter-001` v10 (author_checked_pending_independent_and_owner_review). Review state: independent `changes_requested`, owner `pending`, rights `original_draft_pending_owner_rights_review`.

**Read this first.** Nothing here is approved coverage. The release denominator is the in-scope leaf list below, which is itself a proposal until the independent page/grade audit and the owner approve it. "Authored" means a leaf has general-practice questions and at least one complete exact/similar/generic repair route in the draft batch; it becomes coverage only after review, rights and owner sign-off. Character-group coverage is reported separately and never merged into the skill percentage (owner decision 2026-10-16).

Higher Chinese uses the same leaves and the same shared questions as Chinese. No question is Higher-Chinese-only, so the HCL numbers show shared availability, not evidence of HCL depth.

Every question is single-answer multiple choice with four options. Matching, ordering and two-or-three-option formats are product requirements without a content contract yet.

### Thin repair stock

A route with one item per stage has no spare question: a child who fails a stage meets the same question again on a later day, and every delayed check reuses the one generic item. Reuse is allowed but recorded as repeated exposure, never as new-context evidence.
